Session Cards

Tactical Focus — Opponent Pattern Scan (exact tactical watch)
Why: Build basic tactical awareness by separating repeated patterns from one-off moments.
- Opponent Pattern Scan: 10 minutes, tactical review only. No physical load.
  Step 1: Identify the most repeated movement or exchange pattern.
  Step 2: Choose the clearest opportunity that pattern creates.
  Step 3: Choose the main danger linked to that pattern.
  Step 4: Write one observation to test in training rather than treating it as fact.
  Intent: Look for repetition before making a conclusion.
  Focus: Track the same behaviour across several exchanges.
  Reset: If the pattern appears once, keep watching before acting on it.
  Anchor: Repeated beats random.

Monday — Hard sparring
Why: Your declared hard-sparring/contact session.
- Hard sparring, controlled hard contact. No extra S&C. Keep freshness priority.

Monday — Self-Review Cues
Why: Short tactical check after sparring.
- Self-Review Cues: 2 minutes, RPE 1 max.
  How: Review the last clean technical work.
  Do: Write three cues only, one entry, one defensive reset, one composure cue.

Wednesday — Light technical combat
Why: Keep skill work crisp and low noise.
- Light technical combat session. Keep it skill-first and low fatigue.

Wednesday — Strength
Why: Build power, keep strength, and support your gas tank.
- Tire Flip.
  How: Stand close, chest over the tyre, lift with legs and hips then push forward.
  Dose: 4 sets x 2 reps; rest 120 sec; RPE 8 (max speed intent).
  Cue: Drive hips, push through your legs.
  Easier: Use slower controlled flips, same sets.
  Stop: Stop if low-back pain appears.
- DB Bench Press → Plyo Push-Up.
  How: Heavy dumbbell bench press then step to explosive push-up; keep tight core.
  Dose: 3 rounds: DB bench press 2 reps @ 85% 1RM → plyo push-up 2 reps at max intent; rest 240 sec per round.
  Cue: Tight brace, explode up fast.
  Stop: Stop if shoulder pain or poor control.
- Banded Row (Speed Focus).
  How: Light band load, tall torso, pull hard and fast.
  Dose: 4 sets x 2 reps; rest 120 sec; RPE 8.
  Cue: Pull fast, control the return.
  Stop: Stop if shoulder sharp pain.
- Cossack Squat (Dynamic).
  How: Wide stance, sit low to one side, keep chest up.
  Dose: 2 sets x 6 reps; rest 90 sec; RPE 6.
  Cue: Sit back, keep weight on heels.
  Easier: Reduce depth and range of motion.
  Stop: Stop if knee pain increases.
- Tempo Split Squat (4-0-1).
  How: Front foot steady, lower slowly for four seconds, stand in one second.
  Dose: 2 sets x 6 reps; rest 90 sec; RPE 6.
  Cue: Control the way down.
  Stop: Stop if sharp knee pain.
- Single-Leg Farmer Carry Hold.
  How: Hold weight at your side, stand tall on one leg.
  Dose: 3 holds x 10 sec; rest 120 sec between holds; effort 7/10.
  Cue: Stand tall, squeeze glute.
  Stop: Stop if balance loss or hip pain.

Wednesday — Aerobic support
Why: Build repeatable aerobic base for better recovery and gas tank.
- 5K Steady Run.
  How: Run continuous 5 km at conversational pace.
  Dose: 5 km continuous; conversational pace.
  Cue: Keep easy talking pace.
  Stop: Stop if unusual chest pain or dizziness.

Thursday — Hard sparring
Why: Your declared hard-sparring/contact session.
- Hard sparring, controlled hard contact. No extra S&C. Keep freshness priority.
